name: Dalton Caldwell
person: Dalton Caldwell, co-founder and General Partner of Standard Capital (AI-native Series A firm), Partner Emeritus at Y Combinator (formerly Managing Director/Group Partner), co-hosts the "Dalton & Michael" YC podcast with Michael Seibel. Previously founded App.net (2012, shut down 2017) and imeem. NOT any other Dalton Caldwell.

notes.attribution: He co-hosts the "Dalton & Michael" YC series with Michael Seibel: distinguish his words from Michael's.

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (the "Dear Mark Zuckerberg" 2012 open letter, Lenny's Podcast "Lessons from 1,000+ YC startups," three "Dalton & Michael" YC Library talks, the Partner Emeritus announcement, Standard Capital's site).
1. Walk the YC Startup Library and YC's YouTube channel for more "Dalton & Michael" episodes not yet cited, prioritize ones with substantial Caldwell-specific content (distinguish his words from Michael Seibel's, since they co-host).
2. Find any blog posts he's authored on daltoncaldwell.com beyond the "Dear Mark Zuckerberg" letter, look for the full archive.
3. Any 2025-2026 essay, interview, or talk specifically about founding Standard Capital and the thesis behind an "AI-native Series A firm", what changed for him going from YC partner to fund GP.
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate INTERVIEW/PODCAST appearances of {{PERSON}} beyond the ones already known (Lenny's Podcast "Lessons from 1,000+ YC startups," Fortune 2024 on Requests for Startups).

2. Any interview specifically about the App.net story, founding it in 2012 as a paid Twitter alternative, the funding/pivot arc, and why it ultimately shut down in 2017, his own first-person retrospective on what he learned.

Return exact URLs, priority-marked, 6-10 items with transcripts preferred.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate CRITIQUES and adversarial material on {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known.
